facts.fact: The Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy's held document is the draft National Data Policy 2025, described as a draft reference instrument; the document gives no date beyond its 2025 published year, which is used here.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy

facts.fact: On 2-3 July 2025 stakeholders from government, private sector, civil society and academia endorsed the draft National Data Policy at a national validation workshop, and the EU Delegation says the finalised policy will be submitted for official approval by the Government.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy

facts.fact: The contractor 2M Corp says its Phase 1 work in 2024 for the Ministry of Public Service, World Bank financed, produced a Data Governance Policy and a whole-of-government approach strategy; no adoption by the government is stated.

note: Workshop validated a data inventory of three ministries and reviewed a data governance model; no national data policy is stated as drafted or adopted.
